metadata.description:
From One World to Earth, version 1.0.0, reports the current-evidence-closed, extension-open foundational Earth and Environmental Sciences branch of the Smithian Fold Theory V3 clean-room reconstruction.

The release contains 74 engine-admitted laws across 12 ordered families. Their 18,944 exact candidates yield 74 unique survivors, 296 passing adverse controls, 74 implementation-distinct reconstructions and 74 post-seal empirical-boundary comparisons. Every dependency graph reaches There Is No Nothing; the branch uses zero axioms, zero free or fitted parameters, exact positive-finite Fold arithmetic and no target-selected or opaque predictor.

Headline results derive Earth-system identity, reservoirs, boundaries, observation and absence classes, complete energy/matter/information ledgers, geological order and history, geodynamic, seismic, volcanic, water, ice, atmospheric, ocean, climate, biogeochemical, environmental-quality and hazard-handoff foundations. Exact enumeration predicts earthquake magnitude-frequency exponent 1 before data. The mixed 2010-2020 catalogue remains adverse at N>=5/N>=6 = 18469/1494; the separately preregistered homogeneous 2020-2026 mww holdout is compatible at N>=6/N>=7 = 253/27. Bounded Earth-ionosphere modes and two-basin tipping structure are derived without fitting a dimensional frequency or universal physical threshold.

The V1/V2 audit reviews 763 prior entries and closes all three Earth-owned atomic questions. Twenty-one external source identities contribute 91 preregistered features: 67 are present; 24 absent features and one failed original transport remain preserved. The planned bundle contains PDF and Markdown papers, frozen inventory, derivation audits, claim packages, external evidence, engine receipts and checksums.

metadata.title: From One World to Earth: An Exact, Zero-Parameter and Machine-Closed Foundational Reconstruction of Earth and Environmental Sciences from Smithian Fold Theory
